title: Image of Indian Embassy Counsellor at JAAC Protest in London Is AI-Generated

ai.summary: An AI-generated image falsely claims to show Indian Embassy Counsellor Deepak Raghu at a JAAC protest in London, but verification shows the image does not depict the actual embassy official.

facts.claim: The post identifies the man in the image as Rakesh Dahiya, Secretary of the Indian Embassy
facts.quote: The post identifies the man in the image as Rakesh Dahiya, Secretary of the Indian Embassy.

facts.claim: According to the caption, the Indian Embassy Counsellor, Deepak Raghu, was at the JAAC protest outside Pakistan's High Commission in London
facts.quote: According to the caption, the Indian Embassy Counsellor, Deepak Raghu, was at the JAAC protest outside Pakistan's High Commission in London.

facts.claim: We ran a reverse image search on the image claiming to show Rakesh Dahiya, Secretary of the Indian Embassy
facts.quote: We ran a reverse image search on the image claiming to show Rakesh Dahiya, Secretary of the Indian Embassy.

facts.claim: It led us to the X account of a man named Rakesh Dahiya, who works as the Director of Education in NDMC, Delhi (according to his X bio)
facts.quote: It led us to the X account of a man named Rakesh Dahiya, who works as the Director of Education in NDMC, Delhi (according to his X bio).

facts.claim: We found images of Dahiya from multiple sources, such as the Suffolk Chamber of Commerce, an X post and a Facebook post by Hockey India
facts.quote: We found images of Dahiya from multiple sources, such as the Suffolk Chamber of Commerce, an X post and a Facebook post by Hockey India.

facts.claim: However, he doesn't look similar to the man in the viral image
facts.quote: However, he doesn't look similar to the man in the viral image.

facts.claim: We also searched for Deepak Raghu, who, according to the post, is the Indian Embassy Counsellor and was at the protest
facts.quote: We also searched for Deepak Raghu, who, according to the post, is the Indian Embassy Counsellor and was at the protest

facts.claim: We found that Raghu is a Counsellor at the High Commission of India, London, United Kingdom
facts.quote: We found that Raghu is a Counsellor at the High Commission of India, London, United Kingdom.

facts.claim: The image is AI-generated and doesn't show the Indian Embassy Counsellor at the JAAC protest
facts.quote: The image is AI-generated and doesn't show the Indian Embassy Counsellor at the JAAC protest

ai.background_note: The article reports that an AI-generated image falsely claimed to show an Indian Embassy Counsellor at a protest in London, but verification confirmed it was not the actual official.

problems: name “Indian Embassy Counsellor Deepak Raghu” in the summary does not appear in the article
